messages:
Alex H: quick thread — need alignment on marketplace anchor pricing + SI/hw co-announce timing. thinking we avoid deep discounts at launch but give SI/hw uplift credits.
Priya S: can you spell out the uplift mechanics? are we talking % off list or credit buckets?
Alex H: leaning credit buckets. example: 12-month commit -> $200k credit that can be used for SI services or hw integration fees. non-transferrable after 90 days.
Morgan T: sounds reasonable. question: does credit reduce customer committed spend floor? i.e., do we count $200k against commit?
Ellie P: we should NOT count credits toward contract commit floor. otherwise it kills our ARR. credits are post-commit rebate.
Mark R: agree with Ellie. Also recommend a soft floor discount of 10% for first-year consumption over the commit, then ladder down. keeps economics predictable.
Priya S: ok. timeline for partner announce? AWS partner wants co-announce week of May 20, SI wants two-week runway for joint webinar.
Alex H: proposed schedule: public marketplace listing on May 16, SI joint webinar May 23, partner blog + press coordinated May 24-25. That gives SI time to prep.
marketplace-bot: New offer draft uploaded: https://redwood.app/offers/drafts/marketplace-anchor-2024 (access: partners-only) :sparkles:
Priya S: saw the draft. a couple of redlines: 1) renewal cliff protection for customers moving from monthly to commit; 2) auto-conversion opt-in window needs clarity.
Morgan T: for renewal protection we can include a 6-month smoothing credit that gradually lowers effective price to avoid sticker shock. say 50% for month 1-2, 25% month 3-4, 0% month 5-6.
Ellie P: for auto-conversion opt-in, recommend explicit checkbox + email confirmation. can't enroll customers without consent. legal flagged forced opt-ins.
Alex H: noted. also need to finalise marketplace listing copy to avoid implying HW discount beyond credits — hardware partner asked for separate co-sell language.
Mark R: hardware partner wants a co-marketing SKU: "Appliance+Redwood Starter" with a flat $25k integration credit on qualified deals. keep that outside marketplace price.
Priya S: can we surface two flows on the listing: 1) standard commit offer (credits + ladder) 2) partner-bundled flow that redirects to partner contact form?
Alex H: yup. UI will show primary CTA "Start Commit" and a secondary "Partner Bundle" that routes to partner lead form.
Morgan T: quick math on credits vs discount: if avg deal size $400k, $200k credit is essentially 33% TCV uplift if customers treat it as cost deferral. need guardrails and expiration.
Alex H: guardrails: credits expire 12 months, non-transferable, no commit floor reduction. we'll put a cap: one credit per account per 12 months.
Ellie P: I'll update the renewal language and opt-in flow copy. Priya/Mark can you review draft by EOD tomorrow?
Priya S: on it.
Mark R: will review with HW partner and share redlines by tomorrow noon.
Alex H: thanks. next follow-up: sync Wed 9am PT to lock final numbers and publish offer. if objections, DM me. :thumbsup:
